Subject: Next steps — PR & supplier setup (Coupa/Ariba)

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for the time today — great to learn more about how Acme is planning to rollout LLM features across your product org. Quick recap + a few follow-ups so we can get procurement moving: 

Call recap (2-min):
- You’re evaluating Redwood for production inference across your Recommendations and Search teams.
- Primary procurement owner: Samantha Green (you) with Tom supporting on Coupa configuration.
- Preferred commercial path: looks like PO via standard SOW/contract, but we discussed card for initial POC.

Questions / asks to confirm procurement readiness:
1) Will you be issuing a standard PO (monthly/annual commitment) or do you expect to pay by card for the POC?
2) Are you onboarding vendors through Coupa or Ariba for this purchase? You mentioned Coupa but wanted to confirm supplier ID process.
3) Do you need our W9/tax docs, supplier form, and a Redwood contact for supplier setup?

What I’ll do: I attached a short PR_Guidance.pdf that shows the exact line items customers typically add for our offering (SKU, unit, description, GL code suggestions) plus a vendor onboarding checklist for Coupa/Ariba. If you confirm PO + Coupa I’ll loop in our Sales Ops (Aditya & Monica) to provide the supplier data package (W9, supplier form, sample invoice) and a suggested PR text you can paste into Coupa.

Next steps: 
- Samantha: confirm PO vs card and whether Coupa is the platform (reply to this thread).
- Marissa: if PO/Coupa confirmed, I’ll have Sales Ops prepare the supplier bundle and PR copy by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks —

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the recap and the guidance doc — very helpful. Quick answers below: 

1) Commercial path: we will pursue a PO for the initial 12-month pilot (preferred). We may use corporate card for a short trial if we need to move faster, but procurement will expect a PO for the pilot.
2) Procurement platform: we are on Coupa.
3) Docs needed: yes — please send supplier onboarding form, W9, and a point-of-contact for our vendor onboarding team. Also, can you provide the Redwood legal entity name, remit-to address, and bank wire instructions (if available)?

On our side, I’ll open an internal PR request once I have the supplier info and suggested PR line items. If you can include suggested GL codes and an example invoice that helps speed things up.

Also, one quick Q: do you have an existing AWS Marketplace listing or any marketplace option? Our procurement sometimes prefers marketplace purchases because it avoids supplier onboarding.

Thanks,
Samantha Green
Sr. Procurement Manager, Acme Corporation
samantha.green@acme.com | (206) 555-0199

Folks —

Forwarding the thread — Acme confirmed PO + Coupa. Samantha asked for supplier onboarding docs, W9, remit-to, suggested PR line items, GL codes, and an example invoice. They also asked whether we have a marketplace listing (they prefer marketplace when possible).

Can Sales Ops/Sales Engineering please prepare the following by EOD tomorrow:
- Supplier bundle: Redwood_Supplier_Form.pdf, W9, legal entity + remit address, bank instructions (if we can provide).
- PR guidance: suggested Coupa line items (SKU, description, qty, unit price, total), recommended GL codes (common examples), and a short copy block Samantha can paste into a Coupa PR.
- Example invoice: sample invoice showing billing cadence and PO reference placement.

Aditya: can you also confirm whether we have an AWS Marketplace listing OR a plan to get one quickly? If yes, include the marketplace purchase flow and any timelines.

Thanks — copying Samantha and Tom so they see we’re working on it.

Marissa

Marissa / Monica / Samantha / Tom —

Thanks — happy to own the supplier bundle and PR guidance. See answers + next steps below. I’ve attached the supplier_onboarding_instructions.pdf and redwood_invoice_example.pdf for Acme’s PR team.

Quick answers:
- Marketplace: We do not currently have a public AWS Marketplace listing for the full Redwood product. We can offer marketplace purchase options for certain integrations later this quarter, but for now PO/Coupa is the path.
- Legal entity / remit: Redwood Inference, Inc. | 1500 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94103 | EIN: 12-3456789. Bank wire instructions: (provide on request — we prefer to send via secure portal).

PR guidance (Coupa-specific):
1) Line items (suggested) — paste into PR description in Coupa:
   - SKU: REDW-BASE-12M
     Description: Redwood Inference — Hosted API (12 month commit) — up to X tokens/month. Includes standard SLA and console access.
     Qty: 1
     Unit price: $120,000
     Total: $120,000
     GL suggestions: 5000 (Cloud Services) or 6100 (Third Party SaaS)

   - SKU: REDW-ONBOARD-1
     Description: Professional services — onboarding & integration (estimated 40 hours).
     Qty: 1
     Unit price: $15,000
     Total: $15,000
     GL suggestions: 6200 (Consulting)

2) PR description block (short copy):
   "Purchase of Redwood Inference Hosted API subscription (12 mo) and onboarding services. PO to reference contract #RD-ACME-2026-045. Invoices to be sent to accounts-payable@acme.com. Contact Marissa Cole (marissa@redwoodinference.com) for questions."

3) Invoice example: see attached redwood_invoice_example.pdf — it shows where to put PO number, bill-to, remit-to, and payment terms (Net 30 by default).

Attachments included: supplier_onboarding_instructions.pdf (supplier form + required fields), redwood_invoice_example.pdf (sample invoice), PR_Guidance.pdf (line items & GL mapping).

Next steps (internal):
- Monica: please package the W9 and supplier onboarding PDF into a secure link and send to Samantha with the attachments and the PR description block.
- Marissa: confirm totals and whether we should pursue a marketplace listing for future deals — if Acme wants marketplace path we can start intake but it won’t unblock the PO today.

Samantha / Tom: once you confirm receipt and the PR is opened on your side, please share the Coupa PR ID and we’ll reference it on our invoices.

Thanks —
Aditya Rao
Sales Operations / Solutions
aditya@redwoodinference.com
